summary.text: In personal posts on July 11, 2025, Isaacman emphasized supplying power for AI and warned about the costs of falling behind. In his September 15, 2026 administrator-account post, Isaacman endorsed American AI superiority and described AI as having the potential to elevate nations and change civilizations. His 2026 administrator-account posts highlighted AI's potential to analyze NASA data and the importance of autonomy for missions farther from Earth.
